f0a.rule: For each Discovery year 2021, 2022, 2023, deterministically bind the first owner-calendar-complete seven-day interval beginning at or after 01 February 00:00Z; advance only across declared owner calendar exclusions; no structural result may influence selection.

f0b.selection_rule: Choose the smallest tier whose F0-A measured scaling and headroom can estimate E1 without CAPACITY_EXCEEDED; if month is insufficient choose quarter; if quarter is unsafe stop CAPACITY_INCOMPLETE. Structural results never enter the rule.
